pages.title: Before ERAS opens
pages.note: Anchor dates from the AAMC's 2027 ERAS timeline and the NRMP's 2027 Main Residency Match calendar. Dates shift a little each year; confirm the current ones before you plan around them.

items: Keep a running list of patients, cases and projects that stuck with you
Note attendings and residents who saw your work up close
Try to explore the specialties you're curious about
Ask your school when away rotations get planned

sections.h: Winter and spring before you apply
items: Pick a specialty (or a main one plus a backup)
Ask for letters: CV, talking points, early deadline
Check your specialty's letter and exam expectations
Talk to an advisor and residents in that field
Draft your personal statement
Start your MyERAS application early
Write up experiences while details are fresh
Look up your specialty's program signal rules
Build a first program list and budget
Writer 1: asked / reminded / uploaded
Writer 2: asked / reminded / uploaded
Writer 3: asked / reminded / uploaded
Thank-you notes sent
Submit on the first day if you can (Sept 2, 2026)
Budget fees: $11/program for 1-30, $30 each after, per specialty
Register for the NRMP Match (opened Sept 15, 2026)
Programs start reviewing + MSPE (Sept 23, 2026)
Log every invite and reply quickly
Test camera, light and sound for virtual days
Write notes right after each interview
NRMP standard registration deadline (Jan 29, 2027)

sections.h: February to March: rank and Match
items: Ranking opens (Feb 1, 2027)
Rank in the order you truly prefer
Certify your rank list early (deadline Mar 3, 2027, 9 p.m. ET)
Match Week starts (Mar 15, 2027)
Match Day! (Mar 19, 2027, 12 p.m. ET)
Celebrate (seriously!)
Thank your letter writers and mentors
Watch for your program's onboarding and contract emails
Start the licensing paperwork your program asks for

pins.headline: Residency applications, in order
items: Pick a specialty + ask for letters
Start MyERAS when it opens in June
Submit early in September
Interview season: log every invite
Rank, certify, then Match Day!
